# Small notes on .rgf file format

---

## Intro

*[LMS]: Lego Mindstorms

`.rgf` file is an binary *(as in monochrome)* image format for LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3. It can be exported from [Project Properties](https://ev3-help-online.api.education.lego.com/Retail/en-us/page.html?Path=editor%2FProjectPropertiesPage.html) from [LMS EV3 Home Edition](https://archive.org/download/lms-ev-3-full-setup-1.4.5-en-us-win-32_20260312). *(archive)*

## Structure

`.rgf` file structure
*[LSB]: Least Significant Bit
*[UINT8]: Unsigned 8-bit integer

| Byte(s) | Description | Notes |
| ------- | ----------- | ----- |
| 0 | Image's width (8 - 176) | Image's width **must be divisible by 8**. UINT8 |
| 1 | Image's height (1 - 128) | UINT8 |
| 2 - `ceil(width * height / 8) + 2` | Image's data | Each byte contains 8 pixels (1 pixel per bit). The leftmost pixel for that byte is the LSB of that byte. Read in row-major order |

## Example

![Image containing first 3 stages of GoL glider and 1 Honeycomb GoL still-life. The file contents are 0x10 0x03 0x52 0x64 0x64 0x95 0x27 0x66](/assets/img/content/rgf_format/file.png)

Pixel data shown in binary

```text
01010010 01100100
01100100 10010101
00100111 01100110
```

*[MSB]: Most Significant Bit
[Cyberchef Preview](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/#recipe=Remove_whitespace(true,true,true,false,true,false)From_Binary('None',8)Swap_endianness('Raw',2,false)Generate_Image('Bits',8,16)Flip_Image('Horizontal')&input=MDEwMTAwMTAgMDExMDAxMDAKMDExMDAxMDAgMTAwMTAxMDEKMDAxMDAxMTEgMDExMDAxMTA&oeol=CR). Swapping endianess is equivalent to reversing LSB and MSB. Try removing swap endianess and see what happens!

And for image being flipped. `.rgf` expects preview image to be flipped horizontally. Try extracting `.rgf` file, and setting swap endianess to 22 bytes *(from 176 / 8)*. Without Cyberchef flip image filter. The image is flipped.

[[Cyberchef preview showing uninverted rgf file]](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/#recipe=Find_/_Replace(%7B'option':'Regex','string':'%5E..'%7D,'',true,false,true,false)Swap_endianness('Raw',22,true)Generate_Image('Bits',8,176)Comment('The%20image%20supposed%20to%20read%20FLAG%7BEv3-ruN-l1nuX%7D')Flip_Image('Horizontal'/disabled)&%)
